jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure. You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics. *Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.* Your daily adventure: Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization. Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis. Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from. Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization. Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio. Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices. Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization. Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization. Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights. Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends. Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team. YOUR SKILLS Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus. 5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry. Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis. Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt. Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools). Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow. Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations. Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis. Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation. Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail. Nice to Have: Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation. Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences). Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA). Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review. Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity. Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games. YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS) Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes) Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM) Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday 5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us. Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price. Life Insurance with AXA Office Gym open from 7 AM to 8 PM Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company Language training for English, Spanish, and French Professional development training & programs , based on request Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free Seaside views of the Mediterranean Sea and a rooftop terrace at the office Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good) Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.jd: Why Keyrus , Why Now! A Keyrus é um grupo internacional com 2.800 consultores e especialistas em 28 países , construído sobre uma convicção: a IA não transforma empresas. A inteligência arquitetada transforma. Há mais de 30 anos, construímos as bases de dados que tornam os sistemas inteligentes possíveis, projetando o Sistema Operacional da Empresa Inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada ao núcleo dos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável: operacionalizamos a inteligência. A IA não substitui os seres humanos. Ela nos reposiciona em um lugar que nenhum sistema pode alcançar: compreender, decidir, criar e inovar. Na Keyrus , você não desenvolverá apenas habilidades; desenvolverá discernimento. Sua expertise se fortalece a cada sistema que você projeta, a cada desafio de negócio que ajuda a resolver e a cada implementação que evolui a partir dos aprendizados anteriores. Com o tempo, você se tornará um dos profissionais mais raros da era da inteligência: alguém capaz de conectar dados, IA e tomada de decisão humana em escala, entre diferentes setores, mercados e geografias. Esta não é apenas uma posição. É uma disciplina que você domina e uma história que ajuda a escrever para se tornar um Arquiteto da Inteligência da Keyrus . A tecnologia amplia capacidades. A cultura da Keyrus diferencia. A excelência na execução conecta ambas. O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ ARQUITETAR Como Engenheiro(a) de Inteligência Artificial Sênior, você será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de aplicações inteligentes e soluções analíticas avançadas, transformando dados e necessidades de negócio em produtos inovadores que ampliem a capacidade de geração de insights e tomada de decisão. Projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações corporativas de Inteligência Artificial. Construir assistentes inteligentes, copilotos e interfaces conversacionais integrados a dados e sistemas corporativos. Desenvolver agentes de IA capazes de consultar múltiplas fontes de informação, executar ferramentas e apoiar fluxos de trabalho. Integrar diferentes fontes de dados, possibilitando análises contextualizadas de informações estruturadas e não estruturadas. Garantir a escalabilidade, segurança, qualidade e usabilidade das aplicações desenvolvidas. Implementar mecanismos de rastreabilidade das fontes, validação de resultados e redução de respostas incorretas ou não fundamentadas. Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções de ponta a ponta, desde a identificação de oportunidades até a implantação em produção. QUEM VOCÊ É Você é uma pessoa com sólida experiência em engenharia de software e Inteligência Artificial Generativa, perfil analítico e visão de negócio. Possui autonomia para desenvolver soluções complexas, conectar diferentes fontes de informação e transformar desafios de negócio em aplicações inteligentes, inovadoras e escaláveis. QUEM É VOCÊ Experiência e Qualificações Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações, APIs e integração entre sistemas. Experiência prática com Inteligência Artificial Generativa, Large Language Models (LLMs) e integração de modelos por meio de APIs. Experiência com SQL e integração de diferentes fontes de dados. Conhecimento de arquitetura de dados e tratamento de informações estruturadas e não estruturadas. Experiência com frameworks de desenvolvimento de aplicações e serviços web. Experiência com Git, testes automatizados, CI/CD e boas práticas de engenharia de software. Experiência com ambientes de nuvem e plataformas de dados, como AWS e Databricks. Experiência em decisões técnicas e arquitetura de soluções de média e alta complexidade. Capacidade de desenvolver soluções completas, desde a concepção até a implantação em produção. Capacidade analítica para compreender indicadores, relações entre dados e problemas de negócio. Inglês avançado. Diferenciais: Experiência com frameworks de desenvolvimento e orquestração de agentes de IA, como LangChain, LangGraph ou similares. Conhecimento de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais. Experiência com avaliação, monitoramento e observabilidade de aplicações de IA Generativa. Conhecimento de práticas de LLMOps e MLOps. Experiência com soluções de Intelligent Analytics e interfaces conversacionais para exploração de dados. Conhecimento de práticas de IA responsável, segurança e governança de modelos de IA. O QUE FARÁ VOCÊ TER SUCESSO Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico. Visão sistêmica e orientação aos resultados do negócio. Proatividade para identificar oportunidades e propor soluções inovadoras. Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade pelas entregas. Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções práticas. Curiosidade, criatividade e aprendizado contínuo. Foco na geração de valor e na experiência do usuário. NOSSOS VALORES Inteligência Coletiva A colaboração entre diferentes especialidades, funções e geografias nos permite combinar conhecimento e entregar respostas mais completas para os desafios dos nossos clientes. Confiabilidade A capacidade de entregar projetos complexos com rigor, qualidade e consistência é um dos pilares da nossa relação com clientes e parceiros. Pragmatismo Priorizamos impacto concreto e valor mensurável acima de discursos tecnológicos abstratos. Espírito Empreendedor Curiosidade, energia, autonomia e iniciativa são a base da nossa cultura e impulsionam a inovação contínua. ABOUT KEYRUS Na Keyrus , ajudamos as organizações a evoluir da IA experimental para a IA industrializada, de agentes isolados para sistemas orquestrados e de insights para execução. Essa é a disciplina que chamamos de Architect of Intelligence: desenhar o sistema operacional da empresa inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada aos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável. Impulsionados pelo nosso modelo proprietário Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), estruturamos fundações de inteligência, governança centrada no ser humano e direcioname

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist_IC3
jobs.jd:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Data Analytics and Transformation (DAT) team builds one trusted data foundation driving strategic data-driven decisions across Celonis. We operate through horizontal capability hubs (Data Science & AI, Data Infrastructure, and Process Excellence) alongside vertical domains delivering deep functional insights.

The Data Science & AI hub leverages diverse data (product telemetry, infrastructure, sales motions and much more) to generate governed analytics signals like customer health scores, product depth, and churn. We formulate hypotheses, build predictive models and apply causal inference for actionable insights. Additionally, we develop internal AI agents for diverse use cases utilizing a shared semantic layer to empower organization-wide strategic decision-making.

The Role:

As a Senior Data Scientist in the Data Science & AI team, you will play a key role as a dependable senior contributor who owns complex projects end-to-end. Partnering closely with stakeholders, you will frame ambiguous business problems and drive strategic decisions in a hyper-growth environment. You will leverage your deep analytical and data science expertise to build predictive solutions, design rigorous experiments, and develop GenAI applications (RAG, agents, evals). Beyond modeling, you will translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable narratives, facilitating data-driven discussions and influencing engineers, managers, and executives across the organization.

The work you’ll do:

  • Develop scalable AI/ML solutions, including predictive models, GenAI agents, and advanced decision-making applications for internal use to optimize operational processes and business workflows.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into technical solutions. Own the full modelling lifecycle: from data gathering and pipeline creation to deployment, continuous post-launch monitoring, and model iteration.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners (Product, Engineering, Growth) to drive initiatives by aligning technical capabilities with business goals and influencing decisions through compelling data storytelling and visualizations.
  • Continuously engage to maintain the health, integrity, and automation of data science operations. Refine deployment pipelines and operational workflows to ensure high data quality and rigorous model governance.
  • Act as the dependable expert on the team, elevating technical standards and mentoring junior data scientists in modeling and experimentation best practices.


The qualifications you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Math, Economics) or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of Data Science or ML Engineering experience, with a track record of deploying models into production at scale (SaaS/Enterprise software experience is a plus).
  • Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy) and SQL. Experience with Big Data (PySpark, Databricks) and BI visualization (Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
  • Deep theoretical foundation in statistics and ML, paired with hands-on expertise in frameworks like XGBoost, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
  • Experience building with LLMs, prompt engineering, Vector DBs, and modern GenAI frameworks (LangChain, Hugging Face, FastMCP, Pydantic).
  • Strong command of MLops and model lifecycle management tools like MLflow, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Outcome-driven with strong decision-making skills and the ability to prioritize multiple goals while meeting deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; exceptional attention to detail.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. Who we're looking for: As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location. Develop and optimise manufacturing, and compositional models to advance Makersite's core AI capabilities. Design robust, reproducible, and extensible data pipelines to support model training, evaluation, and delivery. Address data quality, gaps, and complexity across both standardised and customer-specific AI use cases. Translate Research into Production Take AI research and experimentation through to production-ready solutions, collaborating with engineering and product teams to integrate models into Makersite's platform. Evaluate model performance and drive iterative improvements in accuracy, scalability, and practical application. Advance Makersite's AI Strategy Contribute to the evolution of Makersite's AI strategy, identifying opportunities to improve existing models, processes, and capabilities. Research emerging AI approaches and propose improvements to our AI stack and model development practices. Collaborate & Provide Technical Leadership Collaborate with engineering, product, and other stakeholders to translate complex business challenges into AI-driven solutions. Share research findings and provide technical guidance, taking ownership of complex problems from exploration through to delivery. 7+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, AI research, or a related field. Research-oriented background in AI/ML, with demonstrable research contributions such as publications or technical papers. Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and optimising ML models and LLMs. Strong Python skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Pandas. Proven experience taking AI/ML solutions from research and experimentation through to production-level delivery. Strong understanding of data extraction, processing, and pipeline development for AI/ML model training. Manufacturing domain knowledge and experience working with complex B2B or enterprise datasets. Experience collaborating within AI/ML teams and with cross-functional stakeholders. Residing in and legally permitted to work in Germany or the UK. Preferred Experience Experience working with ERP, PLM, manufacturing, supply chain, or sector-specific databases. jobs.jd: ABOUT THE ROLE WIN is seeking highly skilled, hands-on Software Engineers to help build innovative digital applications, AI-powered solutions, and scalable technology platforms. WIN is investing heavily in agentic AI, intelligent automation, and advanced digital platforms to transform how customers access home services and how service professionals deliver them across the $700 billion U.S. home services industry. In this role, you will design and develop software applications, connect internal and external systems, and build intelligent workflows that automate complex business processes. You will work with emerging AI technologies while also contributing to the development of new products and platform capabilities. We are looking for engineers who combine strong software engineering fundamentals with proven experience building real-world AI applications, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and can turn innovative ideas into reliable, production-ready solutions. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Build software applications and platforms: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications, APIs, and services that power WIN's existing and emerging digital products. Develop agentic AI capabilities: Build and enhance intelligent AI agents and automated workflows that can interact with systems, retrieve information, make decisions within defined parameters, and execute actions to complete business processes. Integrate systems and technologies: Develop robust integrations connecting internal applications, third-party platforms, AI services, and external tools using Python, REST APIs, webhooks, MCP, and other integration technologies. Engineer and optimize AI workflows: Integrate and orchestrate LLMs, AI agents, and external services, including evaluating and switching between AI models and providers to improve accuracy, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Ensure reliability and scalability: Build, test, deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot applications and integrations. Implement appropriate safeguards, error handling, and automated testing to ensure secure, dependable performance. Translate business needs into technology solutions: Collaborate with product, technology, and business teams to understand requirements, design technical solutions, and independently deliver working applications and capabilities. Support innovation and product development: Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, contribute to technical architecture, and develop new capabilities that support WIN's expanding digital ecosystem and long-term technology strategy. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python and a proven track record of developing backend applications, APIs, and integrations. Demonstrated experience developing and deploying AI/LLM-powered applications, including agentic workflows, tool calling, or AI-driven automation that interacts with external systems. Strong understanding of software architecture, REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and system integration. Practical experience working with LLM APIs, integrating AI models into applications, and developing workflows that connect AI capabilities with business systems. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, databases, SQL, version control, and modern software development and deployment practices. Strong problem-solving and debugging abilities, with demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining reliable production applications. Ability to independently own technical deliverables, adapt to emerging technologies, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI agent frameworks, or similar tool-integration architectures. Experience building conversational AI, voice AI, or real-time automation solutions. Familiarity with FastAPI, asynchronous programming, microservices, or event-driven architectures. Experience with LLM orchestration, RAG, AI evaluation, and performance optimization. Experience developing customer-facing digital products or platforms connecting multiple services, users, or systems. WHY JOIN WIN? Help develop transformative AI-powered capabilities and digital platforms in the $700 billion U.S. home services industry. Work on meaningful, real-world technology initiatives with the opportunity to see your solutions deployed and used. Be part of a high-energy, collaborative team that values innovation, initiative, ownership, and adaptability. Work closely with India-based and US-based teams. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.jd: Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier. We value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of healthcare. Clover's engineering team is empathetic, caring, and supportive. We are deliberate about the team and culture we are building. We seek engineers who are strong in their own work and care deeply about supporting each other's growth. We are looking for a senior software engineer to make Counterpart Health's existing customer-facing platform agentic. You will build applied AI systems that retrieve relevant information, call tools, and help healthcare users complete meaningful work. You will work with engineers, data scientists, and healthcare professionals, with ownership across data pipelines, backend services, model behavior, and the user experience. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will: Simplify the complexities of healthcare by building systems that multiply human efforts. Build and maintain customer-facing agentic AI software, with ownership from data ingestion through to the user interface. Develop retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, pipelines for ingestion, ETL, storage, indexing, retrieval, and context assembly. Build agent workflows that call tools and use application services, with clear permissions, execution limits, and human review where needed. Choose models, storage, retrieval, and orchestration patterns based on product needs and measured results. Protect PHI and tenant boundaries across data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and outputs in a HIPAA-regulated environment. Use customer feedback and failure analysis to improve answers and tool execution. Measure and improve quality, reliability, latency, and cost. Master new tools and technologies to solve concrete user problems while keeping the system simple enough for the team to maintain and operate. Help the team define development practices that support fast iteration and quality, including tests and documentation of key implementations. Work with Product Managers and operational staff to choose useful workflows, define success, and deliver features to customers. You should get in touch if: You have personally owned a production agentic system used by external customers. You can explain your contribution across ingestion, ETL, storage, retrieval, the tool-calling loop, inference, and UI integration. You have used evaluations to improve a live system. Can explain the test data, failure categories, release criteria, and limits of automated or LLM-as-judge scoring. You bring senior software engineering experience and can write, test, debug, and operate the application code behind an AI feature. Python and TypeScript or JavaScript experience are useful, as is comparable experience in another production language. You have experience with SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud services such as GCP or AWS. You have handled practical LLM limitations, such as context-window limits, unsupported answers, retrieval failures, and incorrect tool calls. Experience with healthcare or another regulated industry is a plus. Experience with tools such as LangGraph, Langfuse, pgvector, or OpenSearch is useful, but we care more about your engineering decisions and production results than a particular framework. Using AI coding assistants, building demos, or shipping internal tools alone does not meet the production AI experience required for this role. You will love this job if: You are curious about how systems work and use pragmatic engineering to solve complicated problems. You test whether an AI approach improves the workflow and use simpler software when it is the better choice. You enjoy a collaborative environment where you help define priorities and own delivery. You bring clarity to ambiguity and change your view when new evidence calls for it. You take responsibility for what reaches customers. You investigate broken behavior, fix the cause, and improve the tests and evaluations that should catch it. You care about what good technology can do for people and want to work with healthcare professionals on tools they can trust. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. jobs.jd: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team Agent Factory is where Workday’s next chapter gets built. We’re forming small, senior, cross-functional AI teams that bring together product leaders, AI engineers, and full-stack builders to create intelligent agents used by millions of people every day. This is production-grade AI—deeply embedded into Workday’s platform—not research experiments or maintenance work. Teams own problems end to end, collaborate tightly across disciplines, and use the right tools to solve real customer challenges at global scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, platform architecture, and human workflows, with the autonomy to shape how agents reason, act, and scale responsibly. High trust, high expectations, and real impact. Engineering, but brighter. About the Role As an AI Engineer in Agent Factory, you’ll design and build the core ML systems behind Workday’s next generation of AI agents. Working within a small, senior, cross-functional pod, you’ll own how models, agent logic, and orchestration layers come together in production—across the full lifecycle from problem framing and data strategy to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. You’ll implement and evolve frameworks for LLM-powered agents, including RAG pipelines, workflow orchestration, evaluation, and feedback loops, ensuring solutions are scalable, observable, and enterprise-ready. This role sits at the intersection of ML and platform engineering: partnering closely with software engineers, product managers, and data scientists to integrate agents deeply into the Workday stack. You’ll stay hands-on with emerging techniques in agentic architectures while applying strong engineering judgment to turn them into systems that are reliable, explainable, and built to operate at global scale. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Foundations
jobs.jd:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Assistance Engineering team builds world-class tools for Airbnb's global network of support agents, so guests and hosts get a great experience 24/7, 365 days a year. Airbnb's operational staff must scale with our user base, and we own the entire tech stack behind their success.
Within Assistance Engineering, Assistance Foundations builds the shared platforms that support runs on: case management, the agent workspace, quality and coaching systems, money tooling, data services, agent routing, provisioning and training, and reliability. We are forming a dedicated Machine Learning Engineering group so that intelligence is built once on this foundation and reused across support, rather than rebuilt by each team. You will be one of its founding engineers.

Some of what we are building and shipping:

  • LLM-based quality evaluation that scores support cases against the quality standard, at scale
  • AI coaching that turns quality evidence into coaching plans for team leads
  • Simulation environments that train agents on realistic support scenarios
  • Natural language search and chat tools that help agents and supervisors find answers faster

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the LLM-based and agentic systems behind quality, coaching, case intelligence, and decision support for agents. The work spans prompt design, retrieval, fine-tuning, agent orchestration, dataset engineering, and evaluation. This is a product-building role: you will take systems from first experiment to production and own how they perform for real users.

A Typical Day: 

  • Design, build, and ship LLM-based and agentic systems, from technical design through implementation, experimentation, and deployment.
  • Build offline and online evaluation (human-labeled sets, LLM-as-judge, A/B tests) so that quality is measured, not assumed.
  • Curate and engineer the datasets that prompts, fine-tuned models, and evaluations depend on.
  • Turn one-off models and prompts into shared components that other Foundations teams can adopt.
  • Collaborate with product, design, engineering, data science, and support operations and quality teams to find high-impact problems and quantify results.
  • Participate in design and code reviews, and mentor other engineers.


Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of industry experience building and shipping applied machine learning, or a PhD in a related field plus 2+ years in industry
  • Recent, hands-on experience building LLM-based systems that shipped to production
  • Expertise in designing and iterating on prompts, fine-tuning, and LLM evaluation
  • Expertise in RAG patterns, memory, tool use, and agent planning
  • Experience integrating LLMs with APIs, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks
  • A solid foundation in machine learning: modeling, evaluation design, experimentation, and A/B testing
  • A track record of shipping AI products used by real users, not only research prototypes or offline models
  • Strong programming (Python, Java, or Kotlin) and the engineering skills to productionize your own work: model serving, monitoring, data pipelines, and safe deployment
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across teams and domains
  • Bachelor's and/or Master's/PhD degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

As a senior researcher in GitLab's Threat Research group, you'll turn emerging security threats into protection for GitLab customers. You'll lead your own research projects, taking ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploying it, and analyzing the results. You'll also keep the detection systems you build running in production.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. We build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster. This is a full-stack research role: you'll combine an adversarial mindset with the software engineering skills to build and operate the systems behind your work.

What you’ll do

  • Lead your own research projects, from the first idea to the published result.
  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with published findings such as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records, responsible disclosures, blog posts, or talks.
  • Experience researching AI agents, large language model (LLM) applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and using AI in real work through LLM application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).
  • The ability to build systems and assess how to break them, with strong Go or Python skills and practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • An understanding of package ecosystems and supply chain attacks, informed by current security and AI industry trends.
  • The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward while balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.
  • Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
  • Helpful but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience, infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu, databases or data pipelines at scale, and reverse engineering.

You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

You don't have to match every listed requirement exactly to be considered. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

About the team

The Threat Research group at GitLab researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical RCE in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. More on the Security Labs blog.

jobs.jd: SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival. We build factories that learn. We sell tangible parts, not software: every part we make produces data on design, cost, process and quality. Our bet is that a factory which learns from that data makes each next part faster, better and with fewer people, and that what one factory learns, every new factory applies. The Role You own the learn and apply steps of our knowledge loop: you say what data the key bet needs and turn it into decisions that engineers and operators use every week. Concretely, you will: Identify the key bet: the decision in our factory, from quoting to quality, where learning from data pays off most Define, with our software engineers, what data we capture from day one Build the first learning-factory MVP yourself and put it in front of engineers and operators within weeks Decide what to build, what to buy and when a model is good enough to trust Show the company and our investors, with numbers, that the factory is learning Grow into the AI Lead role once your MVPs are proven What We're Looking For Several years shipping ML or LLM systems that real users depended on Stack: Strong Python, SQL and data engineering; comfortable from raw data to deployed tool Experience starting from zero data: you have designed what to capture and then built a tool on it Pragmatism: you use whatever method works, from a rule to an agent, judged by what helps the operator in front of you Curiosity for the physical world: you want to stand next to the machine and understand the operator's decision Clear writing and the ability to explain results and their limits Bonus: manufacturing, additive, CNC, CAD or geometry data; early-stage startup experience Language: English. What we're not looking for Researchers without a user: every model you build here has a factory user, or it is dropped Someone who needs clean data, a platform and a team before they can ship Someone who wants to manage first and build later: the lead role is earned by proven MVPs Generic ERP, MES or QMS feature work, or machine interaction: other teams own these What we offer Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the free world. The Team: A small, generalist Manufacturing Intelligence team that ships, reporting to the VP of Manufacturing Intelligence. Compensation: Competitive salary + equity. We're hiring a Senior MLOps Engineer for our Hardware Group to build and scale the machine learning infrastructure that powers Focus, our line of smart cameras. You'll own the edge deployment pipelines that transport neural networks from training clusters to tens of thousands of devices globally, and contribute to the platform that compiles trained models into optimised inference engines for devices like the Jetson Orin, building the "nervous system" for the next generation of automated sports capture.

As a Senior MLOps Engineer, you'll:

  • Build scalable Edge infrastructure. You'll design, develop, and maintain the delivery systems that enable us to deploy models to fleets of devices.
  • Own the model compilation platform. You'll build and maintain the pipeline that takes trained models and produces optimised, hardware-specific inference engines — managing TensorRT compilation, precision trade-offs (FP16/INT8), calibration, and engine validation to ensure models run reliably and efficiently on target devices.
  • Work with cross-functional teams. You'll collaborate with Data Scientists, Embedded Engineers, and Product Managers to ensure smooth integration of complex features and capabilities
  • Drive automation and reliability. You'll implement infrastructure to silently test candidate models on production devices and build telemetry pipelines to monitor drift, thermal impact, and inference latency in the wild.
  • Solve complex physical challenges. You'll tackle the unique constraints of the edge - building resilient update mechanisms for low-bandwidth environments, optimising for limited storage, and ensuring devices recover gracefully from network failures.
  • Mentor and lead. You'll share your expertise to establish best practices in Python tooling, Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD, guiding the team toward a more robust, automated future.

Location

We'd like to hire someone for this role who lives near our offices in London or Barcelona, but we're also open to remote candidates in the UK and Spain.

Must-Haves

  • Production MLOps expertise. You've played a key role in building and operating pipelines that deploy models to production, with deep experience in CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and Linux systems.
  • Collaborative. You understand that shipping to hardware is a team sport and can communicate effectively with researchers and low-level embedded engineers to translate constraints into solutions.
  • Systems thinking. You can design architectures that handle failure gracefully and understand the implications of deploying to 10,000 heterogeneous devices, including how to manage risk via canary releases and safe rollbacks.
  • Bias towards action. You see your role as solving problems; this means filling gaps and taking initiative as needed to help the team win together.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Edge inference & compilation know-how. You have hands-on experience compiling and optimising models for embedded hardware - ideally with TensorRT - and understand the practical implications of precision, quantisation, and engine validation at scale.
  • Experience with our Edge AI stack. Experience with the NVIDIA edge ecosystem (Jetson Orin, DeepStream SDK, TensorRT) is a huge plus.
  • Video Technologies. Familiarity with video pipelines, GStreamer, or ffmpeg.
  • Fleet management. Experience with tools like AWS IoT Greengrass, Balena, or custom OTA / fleet management solutions.
  • Sports Passion. You have an interest in sports technology, video analytics, or performance metrics—but if not, we'll teach you the domain.

Grow with us: take on more ownership, more complex projects and, if you want it, a path towards technical leadership as you prove yourself. Solid experience in GenAI / AI Engineering or ML / Data Science that you have helped take to production. Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, CI/CD and clean, readable code. Good at problem decomposition and software design: you can turn requirements into a well-structured solution and explain the trade-offs. Experience with Data Platforms & Cloud (Azure, AWS) is a plus. How We Hire Our hiring process includes a live coding interview without AI assistance, a technical design discussion and a client case study. Each client is different Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts ( https://github.com/unit8co/darts ) or building our own MLOps platform. Tailor-made mentorship programme. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Growth Alliance (all genders)
jobs.jd:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, and Youfoodz.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech-a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization, pricing, and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each holding accountability for a specific product domain end to end. In this role, you will join an assigned squad, with the flexibility to transition between teams and projects as technical objectives and business priorities evolve.

Several high-impact machine learning domains are actively hiring, and your project and team placement will be aligned based on your individual strengths, interests, and expertise during the interview process. Key domains include:

  • Risk, Fraud & Payments (Growth Alliance): You will own production ML systems that protect HelloFresh from checkout fraud and intelligently recover failed recurring payments (such as Smart Payment Retry) via low-latency scoring on Databricks.
  • Personalization & Conversions (Growth Alliance): You will build real-time decisioning systems, customer win-back models, and scalable GenAI content pipelines that tailor journeys and messaging across visitor and customer funnels.
  • Dynamic Pricing & Customer Value Optimization (Growth Alliance): You will architect and scale the core Pricing Engine to drive pricing optimization and forecasting across 8 brands, 34 markets, and all weekly menus.

Across all domains, you will work on scalable, high-availability production ML systems serving global architectures. Please note that this is an individual contributor role and does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh, we are moving away from a model where engineers simply execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. As a Product Engineer, you will take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

  • Build and operate data products and machine-learning systems, taking them from experimentation through production and owning their real-world performance.
  • Architect and optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark on Databricks, Kafka), feature stores, and low-latency serving infrastructure.
  • Improve inference performance, reliability, and compute cost by profiling bottlenecks, right-sizing infrastructure, and maintaining tight latency targets with dependable fallback mechanisms.
  • Establish and raise modern MLOps standards across teams, including CI/CD automation, model registry versioning, infrastructure as code (Terraform), automated validation gates, and drift detection.
  • Design and execute rigorous experimentation frameworks from A/B tests and holdouts to off-policy evaluation-to credibly measure model impact on core business metrics.
  • Build and scale domain-specific applied AI solutions, ranging from real-time scoring and contextual bandits to production GenAI pipelines with automated quality gates.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to pressure-test models for production readiness, mentor teammates, and leverage AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Cursor) to accelerate engineering delivery.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

  • 5+ years building and operating live ML systems in production, paired with the statistical literacy to design sound experiments and interpret their results.
  • Hands-on experience building product-facing ML solutions directly tied to measurable business metrics (such as conversion, retention, revenue, or risk reduction).
  • Deep command of Python, SQL, and large-scale data processing (PySpark on Databricks), paired with solid software engineering practices (testing, clean code, version control) and familiarity with low-latency serving or backend languages like Go.
  • Hands-on background with cloud environments (AWS), containerization, automated CI/CD, and modern ML or orchestration tooling such as Databricks Model Serving, MLflow, SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, or Terraform.
  • Practical, day-to-day fluency with AI coding tools (like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot) beyond casual experimentation—knowing how to structure context and set clear boundaries on AI-generated work.
  • A quality-first mindset around model evaluation, drift monitoring, and A/B testing pitfalls for ML systems to ensure bad data or outputs never reach customers.
  • A bias to ship ("finishing the last twenty percent"), strong product sense backed by data, and clear communication skills across international, multi-disciplinary teams.

Nice to have:

  • A track record of optimizing data and ML pipelines for performance and cost at scale.
  • Experience with contextual bandits and off-policy evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience building and running production LLM pipelines.
  • Background in churn prediction and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling.
  • Prior experience in high-growth consumer tech or subscription-based businesses.

jobs.jd: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI Safety Evaluations
jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, Remote
jobs.jd: NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Realizing that potential means answering some of the hardest questions in AI: Where do models fall short? Which risks are we missing? How do we know our safeguards are working? As an expert in machine learning for Evaluations, you’ll help establish the evidence that guides the next generation of safer AI. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. Engaging directly in engineering tasks, you will apply your data science and statistics skills. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like. What You Will Be Doing: Safety Benchmarking: Design and maintain safety benchmarks for large language and multimodal models, translating risk scenarios into test cases, datasets, and scoring rubrics. Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise. Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases. Automated Red-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment. Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues. Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision-makers. What We Need To See: Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation. Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments. Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment-tracking workflows. Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence. Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red-teaming. Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks. Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues. Human-Aligned Evaluation: Experience validating model-based evaluators against human judgments or designing human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows. Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands. Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain. The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority. What You Will Do: Technical leadership & core development Drive core development of transformative capabilities. Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives. Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management. Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases. Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner. Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups. Market observation & innovation Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company. Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability. Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers. Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements. Cross-organisation delivery & architecture Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions. Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI
jobs.jd: About Us: Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less. The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI (Remote - USA / Canada) We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI to join our Agentic Systems team, where you'll build AI agents that automate workflows for teams across Wrapbook. You'll partner directly with internal teams like Marketing, Sales, Support, Operations and Finance to find high-leverage processes, then design, ship and iterate on agents that take real work off their plates. This is a chance to define how a 400+ person company runs on AI. You'll see the impact of your work every day, while shaping the patterns, tools and standards for how we build agents at Wrapbook. What You’ll Do: Design and build production-grade AI agents with LangGraph that automate multi-step workflows for internal teams across Wrapbook Deploy, run and scale agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using its runtime, memory, identity and gateway capabilities to make them secure and reliable, while tracking what they cost to run and keeping it efficient as usage grows Partner with internal teams to find high-impact workflows, draw out requirements from people who can't hand you a spec, and turn them into agent-driven solutions, explaining clearly what each agent can and can't reliably do Integrate agents with Wrapbook's internal systems, APIs and third-party tools so they can take real actions, not just answer questions Build evaluation, observability and guardrail frameworks to measure agent quality, catch failures and keep humans in the loop where it matters Establish reusable patterns, shared tools and best practices that let the Agentic Systems team ship new agents quickly and consistently Own agents end to end, from prototype to production, measuring their impact on the teams they serve and iterating based on usage data and feedback Drive adoption through clear documentation, training and enablement, so teams understand what each agent does, trust it and know how to get the most from it What You’ll Have: 6+ years of back-end development experience with Python, TypeScript/Node.js or Java, with a track record of delivering systems built for security, scalability, availability and performance Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered agents or workflows (with models such as Claude, GPT, Llama or Mistral), including prompting, tool use and structured outputs. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Anthropic (m/f/d)
jobs.location: Berlin, Berlin; Hamburg, Hamburg; München, Bavaria Germany
jobs.jd:
About us

Artefact is a data and AI services company with around 2,500 people across 36 offices. We are part of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network and have rolled out Claude across our own organization, so our advice to clients comes from running it ourselves first.

DeployCo is Artefact's team dedicated to deploying Claude at scale inside enterprises. It works through three levers. Deployment and adoption gets organizations from a few early adopters to company-wide use. Process reimagination redesigns core workflows around agentic AI. Agent production ships working agents into client systems. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders behind the third lever and the technical backbone of the other two.

The role

As an FDE you join a client's own AI or engineering team as a builder, not an advisor. You design, code, and ship production-grade Claude solutions directly inside their stack, following their conventions, repositories, and CI. You also leave the capability behind, so that when the engagement ends the client's engineers can extend and maintain what was built without us.
The work ranges from short, intense engagements, like standing up a governed Claude Code deployment in a few weeks, to longer embeds where you become the technical anchor of a multi-agent portfolio and a larger Artefact pod grows around you. This is a senior role, and we expect you to own technical direction on an engagement from the first week.

What you'll do

  • Build production agents. Design and deploy Claude-based agents and workflows that run in production, with the engineering standards that implies. That means tests, error handling, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Connect Claude to enterprise systems. Build custom MCP servers and connectors to business applications and data sources, enforcing the client's own access rules. This includes permissions, traceability, and segregation of rights.
  • Engineer the context layer. Contribute to Artefact's context platform approach, including deterministic authentication before data reaches the model, user-level context injection, and observability for token spend and security.
  • Deploy and govern Claude Code. Set up SSO and role-based access, managed settings, approved MCP servers and plugin marketplaces, permission modes, sandboxing, and OpenTelemetry-based usage monitoring. Help clients choose between deployment options (Team, Enterprise, cloud providers, gateways) based on security, data residency, and cost.
  • Build reusable skills. Turn client workflows into Claude Skills and shared skills libraries that teams can find, reuse, and build on.
  • Enable client engineers. Pair program, review code, document patterns, and deliver hands-on Claude Code training and labs, sometimes to cohorts of dozens of developers and sometimes to CTOs and engineering leaders.
  • Feed the product loop. Capture deployment pitfalls and product feedback from the field and share it with Anthropic through our partnership.

What you bring

  • Senior-level experience in software engineering or data science, with production systems you have shipped and operated
  • Recent, hands-on work with the GenAI stack, going beyond prototypes. This includes tool use, agent design, retrieval, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.
  • Demonstrated depth with Claude in particular, such as Claude Code, the Claude API, Skills, or MCP, and a point of view on how the stack is evolving
  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and solid grounding in enterprise integration, including APIs, identity and access management (SSO, OAuth, SCIM), and cloud platforms
  • Confidence in client-facing settings, explaining technical trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders, and running a workshop when needed
  • Fluent in German and English 

Nice to have

  • Anthropic certification (Claude Certified Developer or Architect) is welcome but not expected, since it is usually only available through a partner company. We support you in earning it once you join.
  • Experience building and securing MCP servers
  • Background in security, observability (OpenTelemetry), or FinOps for AI workloads
  • Experience in regulated industries such as banking, asset management, or pharma
  • A track record of teaching or technical training

What we offer

  • Direct work with Anthropic's partner and applied AI teams, including co-delivered labs
  • Varied, high-impact engagements across EMEA in finance, retail, industry, and consumer goods
  • A clear path from FDE to technical anchor of a full AI delivery pod
  • Certification support and dedicated learning time

 

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!
Ready to take the next step? Please submit your CV showcasing your experience and passion for this role as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Anthropic (m/f/d). We look forward to receiving your application!
 

If you have any questions, feel free to send us a message at ----- Find

jobs.jd: If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/ About Us Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process. About the Role We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short-form clips against long-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision. Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office. You Will - Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade-offs explicit between short-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other. - Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data. - Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months. - Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap. - Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality. - Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists. Perks - Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance - 401(k) - Maternity & Parental Leave - Flexible PTO - Amazon Employee Discount About the team Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery & ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back. - 3+ years of data scientist experience - A BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience. - 3+ years as a data scientist in a high-velocity, data-driven environment, with hands-on experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning (regression, classification, causal inference, time series), including the assumptions behind each method and when it fails. - Experience designing and analyzing online experiments, including variance reduction, power analysis and the pitfalls of interpreting results. - Expert SQL and proficiency in Python or R. - A track record of using data and models to influence product decisions and leadership. - An MS or PhD in a quantitative field. - Experience with recommender systems, search ranking or feed ranking, such as offline evaluation (precision and recall, NDCG), exploration versus exploitation, or cold-start problems. - Experience with multi-objective optimization or with defining objective functions for ranking systems, including choosing weights between competing goals. - Experience building proxy metrics for long-term outcomes, or estimating long-term effects from long-running holdouts or observational data (e.g., difference-in-differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling). - Experience with two-sided platforms or marketplaces, where changes for viewers also affect creators or supply. - Experience on a consumer content platform: streaming, short-form video, social or marketplaces. - Familiarity with Twitch, as a viewer or a creator (or both!).
